item.title: Echigo Mountains & Sea of Japan Coastline: A Landscape of Contrasts — Guide
item.description: Niigata’s geography is defined by a striking contrast between the snow-capped Echigo mountain ranges inland, among Japan’s snowiest regions, and the rugged Sea of Japan coastline stretching along the prefecture’s western edge. Scenic coastal roads wind past dramatic cliffs, fishing villages and sunset viewpoints over the Sea of Japan, while inland routes climb into the mountains through forests and terraced rice paddies, together showcasing the full range of Niigata’s varied natural landscape within a single road trip.
